question: Can a second-competing retention floor preserve competing hypotheses through consolidation without touching the decay constant, and does preserving them produce a late recall@5 gain over shipped 0.95?

scope.instrument: benchmarks/long_delay_capability.py -- the online next-cycle recall@5 instrument, k = 5
scope.burst_excluded: burst_L1 is excluded: Q052 amendment A2 classified its late collapse DIFFERENT_SUPPORT_COLLAPSE, so it is not a second instance of this mechanism and may not be pooled. A burst block would need its own matched arms.
scope.why_this_family: the mechanism's evidence is the lattice death, where six subjects retain two pairs each and no subject retains two competing hypotheses

mechanism.name: second-competing retention floor
mechanism.changes: at the consolidation prune, for each subject that still holds hypotheses, keep the highest-support hypothesis of each of the subject's top two expectations, exempt from the death threshold. Every other candidate is pruned exactly as shipped.

parameter.order: expectations ordered by their best hypothesis's support_count descending; ties broken on the expectation tag
parameter.scope: applies per subject, inside the existing prune pass; no other layer changes

preserves: the candidate set and which structures compete
does_not: displace high-support structure outside the subject
mechanism.prediction: the control's death leaves subjects holding two retention pairs but no subject holding two competing expectations, so exempting the top two expectations keeps exactly the structure theory formation needs, and can raise the late competition share without moving any decay constant
mechanism.risk: a stale minority survives on old evidence and competes with the current best, which is why the capability criterion and the early-cost bound are judged separately rather than merged into one score
mechanism.off_by_one: if a subject holds one expectation only, the floor keeps it and adds nothing; the mechanism cannot manufacture competition

control.rule: the shipped engine, no subclass, no-op

treatment.rule: the shipped engine plus the second-competing retention floor at the prune

design.pairing: both arms of a seed run on the same seed-determined world; only the service class differs
design.freshness: the first contiguous window of eleven integers at or above 20410101 that appears in no artifact, harness, test, document or journal in the repository; the eleventh is the bootstrap seed and is not a world seed

M1_mechanism.quantity: late-window competition share -- the fraction of late cycles in which at least one subject retains two competing hypotheses
M1_mechanism.rule: median per-seed gap (treatment minus control) at or above the manipulation bar
M1_mechanism.bar_provenance: declared, not calibrated: no committed block measures this quantity, so there is no honest calibration set, and the bar is placed where the manipulation is visible rather than marginal. It is a manipulation check, not a capability criterion.
M1_mechanism.on_failure: the capability endpoint is unread, because the mechanism did not operate; this is an unrun experiment, not a null

C1_capability.quantity: late-window recall@5 over cycles 240-300, median per-seed gap (treatment minus control)
C1_capability.rule: median gap at or above the bar, bootstrap interval lower bound above zero, and at least seven of ten seeds with a positive gap
C1_capability.bar_provenance: carried as policy from Q051's confirmatory block: one half of its measured late median gap, 0.0265 / 2 = 0.01325, rounded up to 0.0133. It is NOT calibrated on this layer, this contrast or this mechanism; a pass means the treatment cleared a bar fixed before this block ran.

C2_early_cost.quantity: early-window recall@5 over cycles 40-90, median per-seed gap
C2_early_cost.rule: median gap at or above the early-cost bound
C2_early_cost.bar_provenance: Q051's early equivalence margin, carried unchanged; a larger early loss prices the trade and blocks adoption

gates.G1_liveness: the control's late theory count must be zero in at least 90 percent of its late cycles on every seed; if the control survives, the block compares two live arms and is void
gates.G2_noop_control: the control's structure fingerprint must equal the shipped engine's fingerprint recorded in the run artifact
gates.G3_determinism: the control re-run on the first seed must reproduce its recorded fingerprint
gates.G4_persistence_confound: both arms must record decay 0.95 and death threshold 0.15 in the run artifact; a treatment that differs on either is void, because the mechanism may not buy its effect with persistence
gates.G5_seed_block: the cells must be exactly the frozen block, with both arms of every seed and no cell outside it
gates.G6_denominator: every cell must report at least one prediction in each window; a cell with none is not measurable and the block is void
gates.void_rule: a failed gate voids the block and no criterion is read

decision_table.reading: the block is unrun; the gate that failed names what did not happen, and no criterion is read
the floor did not raise the late competition share, so the capability endpoint was never run; this is not evidence that preservation cannot help

decision_table.condition: gates pass; M1 passes; C1 passes; C2 passes
decision_table.reading: the mechanism keeps competing hypotheses alive and the late ranking gain clears the bar without an early cost; adoption is still an owner decision and is not implied by the label

decision_table.condition: gates pass; M1 passes; C1 fails
decision_table.reading: preservation is real and insufficient: the preserve-to-capability link is not established, and the mechanism is recorded without adoption

decision_table.condition: gates pass; M1 passes; C1 passes; C2 fails
decision_table.reading: the late gain is bought with early ranking, so the trade is priced and nothing is adopted

decision_table.condition: gates pass; M1 passes; C1 interval wider than 0.30
decision_table.reading: the block cannot separate a gain from zero; this is reported as underpowered rather than as a negative

adoption.rule: a capability gain is necessary but not sufficient: the mechanism must also pass M1, clear C1, keep C2, and pass every gate; adoption then requires a recorded owner decision, and nothing in this block changes the engine by itself
not_authorised: a second mechanism or a parameter sweep of this one
pooling burst_L1 cells into this block
re-scoring a criterion after the block runs

stop_condition: one mechanism, one protocol, one confirmatory block of twenty cells. The record may be fixed if it is found wrong; it may not grow into a second mechanism, a second endpoint or an additional block without a new preregistration.

cost.note: no cell has run; the cost is stated so the block is not opened casually
